moments.text: Upright phone video at night, lower half blurred for privacy. A small bright light sits just left of centre at a thin overhead wire.
The sky tints pink, then the whole frame flashes pink-white for 4 frames (about 0.15 s) before the view returns. Use frame step.
The light sits on the upper wire near the centre, barely moving. Frame by frame, its colour flickers between white, green, red and violet.
Still on the wire, the light shrinks to a fainter point for about two seconds, then brightens again.
The camera tilts and swings, smearing the light into streaks, then settles with it right of centre above the wire, a pole at left.
With the camera mostly still, the light hangs just above the wire and slowly opens a gap above it.
The camera drifts twice, sliding the light to the right of centre and back (6:54-7:08 and 7:42-7:56).
Held steady again, the light sits clearly above the wire now, the gap still slowly widening; the colour flicker continues.
Late on, the light sits well above the wire with fainter points nearby; the camera twice shifts it into the left third (13:30, 14:42).

notes: Review tool's old auto-crop 608:698:0:382 (live has no crop; tool fixed) keeps mostly the privacy-blurred bottom; the light and wires are in the top third. No black bars: crop should be cleared or moved up.
